value.name: Daniel accepts comforting touch
value.description: Daniel remains still and does not pull away from the physical comfort being offered to him.

value.name: Asha gives Daniel and Rosa a moment
value.description: Asha looks down at the letter and deliberately lets Daniel and Rosa have a private moment.
evidence: Asha looked down at the letter and gave them a moment.

value.name: Daniel regains composure
value.description: After a pause, Daniel lifts his head and his expression changes from grief to something harder to name.
evidence: After perhaps thirty seconds Daniel lifted his head.
His face was dry but the expression on it had changed in a way that Asha did not have a name for.

value.name: Daniel confronts Rosa
value.description: Daniel turns his attention to Rosa and accuses her of knowing about the will change.

value.name: Rosa denies knowing the will contents
value.description: Rosa insists she knew the will had been changed but did not know how it had been changed or what it said.
evidence: "Daniel. I did not know. I knew she had changed the will. I did not know what she had changed it to. She did not tell me. I would not have let her — I would have told her no. She knew that. That is why she did not tell me."

value.name: Daniel repeats accusation
value.description: Daniel presses Rosa again, insisting that she knew about the change.

value.name: Rosa explains her relationship to the house
value.description: Rosa says she is not the kind of person who would take a third of the house and describes herself as someone who serves in the back bedroom.
evidence: "I am not — Daniel. I am not a person who takes a third of a house. I am a person who lives in a back bedroom and washes the dishes."

value.name: Daniel acknowledges mother's love for Rosa
value.description: Daniel tells Rosa that his mother loved her, and Rosa agrees.
evidence: "You are a person my mother loved."

value.name: Daniel compares mother's love
value.description: Daniel suggests his mother loved Rosa more than him, and Rosa rejects that interpretation.

value.name: Daniel reconsiders childhood arithmetic
value.description: Daniel stares at Rosa while Asha senses him painfully undoing a long-held childhood calculation about his mother's love.
evidence: He looked at her a long time.
Asha had the impression that some small piece of arithmetic he had been doing since he was nine years old was being slowly, painfully, undone in front of her.
